import hashlib, json, subprocess, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
root = Path('products/distribution/sqlite-instructor-pilot')
shared = Path('products/sites/sqlite-statement-diagnostic/index.html').read_bytes()
base = (root / 'reconciliation/live-index.html').read_bytes()
patch = (root / 'placement/index.diff').read_bytes()
def digest(contents):
    return hashlib.sha256(contents).hexdigest()
receipt = {'live_sha256': digest(base), 'shared_sha256': digest(shared)}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
    work = Path(directory)
    for name, contents in [('live.html', base), ('shared.html', shared), ('preview.html', base)]:
        (work / name).write_bytes(contents)
    applied = subprocess.run(['patch', '--batch', '--forward', 'preview.html'], input=patch, cwd=work, capture_output=True)
    receipt['standalone_patch_exit'] = applied.returncode
    if applied.returncode == 0:
        preview = (work / 'preview.html').read_bytes()
        receipt['standalone_preview_sha256'] = digest(preview)
        merged = subprocess.run(['git', 'merge-file', '-p', 'shared.html', 'live.html', 'preview.html'], cwd=work, capture_output=True)
        receipt['merge_exit'] = merged.returncode
        receipt['merge_stderr'] = merged.stderr.decode(errors='replace')[:1000]
        if merged.returncode == 0:
            (work / 'merged.html').write_bytes(merged.stdout)
            reverse = subprocess.run(['git', 'merge-file', '-p', 'merged.html', 'preview.html', 'live.html'], cwd=work, capture_output=True)
            receipt['reverse_merge_exit'] = reverse.returncode
            receipt['reverse_restores_shared'] = reverse.returncode == 0 and reverse.stdout == shared
            if receipt['reverse_restores_shared']:
                receipt['merged_sha256'] = digest(merged.stdout)
                (root / 'reconciliation/three-way-preview.html').write_bytes(merged.stdout)
    if 'merged_sha256' not in receipt:
        (root / 'reconciliation/three-way-preview.html').write_bytes(b'<!-- No verified merged preview was produced. See three-way-result.json. -->\n')
receipt['scope'] = 'Offline merge rehearsal. No shared site edits or publication.'
(root / 'reconciliation/three-way-result.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(receipt))

The same patch failed on the shared candidate, which contains separate private-quote edits. Test a three-way merge in temporary storage and preserve the verified standalone preview if the changes conflict or their owners have yet to agree on release scope.
